name: Carly
tagline: One assistant you can text, with no credits to count.
metaTitle: Carly AI Alternative: A Personal Assistant You Can Text
metaDescription: Looking for a Carly AI alternative? GAIA handles email, calendar and tasks from iMessage, WhatsApp, web and desktop, on one plan with no credits to count.
whyPeopleLook: Carly made email the interface: CC an agent and it books the meeting or files the invoice. That works well for scheduling and back-office chores. People look for an alternative when they want one assistant rather than several agents to configure, a place to talk to it beyond email and SMS, a full app for longer work, or predictable pricing instead of credits that run out and must be topped up by hand.
painPoints: Several agents to set up, each with its own integrations and permissions
AI usage metered in credits that you top up by hand
No web or desktop workspace for longer work beyond the dashboard
Not reachable from WhatsApp, Telegram, iMessage or Discord
Proprietary, with no way to self-host or read the code
gaiaReplaces: CC-ing an agent to book meetings from email threads
Inbox sorting rules you set up for each agent
Scheduled tasks that cost credits each time they run
Switching between agents for different chores
gaiaAdvantages: Text it from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack or Discord
One assistant with memory you can see, edit and delete
Workflows on a schedule or triggered by Gmail, Calendar, Slack and GitHub
A desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
migrationSteps: List the chores your Carly agents handle each week
Connect Gmail or Outlook, your calendar and your task tool to GAIA
Rebuild the most-used chore as a GAIA workflow
Link the chat app you use most and ask GAIA from there

faqs.question: What is the best Carly AI alternative?
faqs.answer: If you want to keep CC-ing a scheduling assistant on email, other email-first schedulers are closer. If you want one assistant you can text from your chat apps, with web and desktop apps and workflows across your tools, GAIA is the closer fit.

faqs.question: Does GAIA have an AI receptionist like Carly?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not make or answer phone calls. Teams that need phone handling should keep Carly or another phone service for that.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost?
faqs.answer: GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).

faqs.question: How do I switch from Carly to GAIA?
faqs.answer: List what your Carly agents do, connect your email, calendar and task tool to GAIA, then rebuild the busiest chore as a workflow. Keep Carly for anything that depends on its phone add-ons or an app GAIA does not connect to.
